Alternatives: Create a new email campaign (M15.A01) with an SMS or Email channel to announce the webinar to your contact list.; Draft an email (M13.A01) to specific key contacts inviting them to the webinar.

reply.reason: Posting to LinkedIn is not supported by the current actions. The available social/community posting tools (e.g., 'Create community post', 'Publish post') are also marked as not available in this version.
alternatives: Draft a campaign message step for an email or SMS announcement using M15.A05 if you have a campaign ID.
Create an appointment or task to remind your team to manually post on LinkedIn.
